storyOrigin: It started with a frustrating search. A founder relocated for work and faced the same choice everyone does: a tiny hotel room with no kitchen, or a 12-month lease on an empty apartment. Neither made sense. So we built a third option.
storyMission: In 2024, NEOS launched with a simple idea: beautiful, furnished apartments you can move into tomorrow. Every home is hand-picked, fully equipped, and located in neighborhoods where you'd actually want to live.
storyToday: Today, we're the go-to choice for professionals who need a real home, not a temporary fix. Tech leads, consultants, medical residents, relocating families — they all stay with us because we treat every stay like it matters. Because it does.
